```{r setup}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Arms imports

## Load data

```{r}
# arms import data
arms <- read_csv("../Data/ArmsImports.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1"), skip = 11)
arms <- filter(arms, !is.na(Category))
naval_arms <- subset(arms, Category %in% c("A", "B"))
```

## Total arms

```{r}
arms %>%
  mutate(Period = floor((`Year of order` + 1) / 5)) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  summarize(TIV = sum(`SIPRI TIV for total order`)) %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(str_c(Period * 5 - 1, Period * 5 + 3, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = TIV, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Year of Order") +
  ylab("SIPRI Trend Indicator Value") +
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45))
```

## Naval arms

```{r}
naval_arms %>%
  filter(`Year of order` > 1963) %>%
  mutate(Period = floor((`Year of order` + 1) / 5)) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  summarize(TIV = sum(`SIPRI TIV for total order`)) %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(str_c(Period * 5 - 1, Period * 5 + 3, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = TIV, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("The Indian Navy's Rising Arms Imports (1964-2023)") +
  labs(caption = "*Based on unit production costs") +
  xlab("Year of Order") +
  ylab("SIPRI Trend Indicator Value*") +
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
ggsave("../Images/arms_total.jpg")
ggsave("../Images/arms_total_presentation.jpg", width = 9.5, height = 4.2)
```

```{r}
arms %>%
  filter(`Year of order` > 1948) %>%
  mutate(Period = floor((`Year of order` + 1) / 5)) %>%
  group_by(Period, Category) %>%
  summarize(TIV = sum(`SIPRI TIV for total order`)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Period, names_from = Category, values_from = TIV, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Naval = A + B,
         Total = A + B + C + D + E,
         Proportion = Naval / Total) %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(str_c(Period * 5 - 1, Period * 5 + 3, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = Proportion, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Year of Order") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## By country

```{r}
naval_arms %>%
  filter(`Year of order` > 1963) %>%
  mutate(Period = floor((`Year of order` + 1) / 5),
         Supplier = case_when(str_detect(Supplier, "Denmark|France|Germany|Italy|Netherlands|Spain|Sweden|United Kingdom") ~ "Western Europe",
                              Supplier == "Soviet Union" ~ "Russia",
                              TRUE ~ Supplier)) %>%
  group_by(Period, Supplier) %>%
  summarize(TIV = sum(`SIPRI TIV for total order`)) %>%
  filter(Supplier %in% c("Russia", "United States", "Western Europe")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Supplier, values_from = TIV, values_fill = 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Period, names_to = "Supplier", values_to = "TIV") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(str_c(Period * 5 - 1, Period * 5 + 3, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = TIV, color = Supplier, group = Supplier)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Year of Order") +
  ylab("SIPRI Trend Indicator Value") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
naval_arms %>%
  filter(`Year of order` > 1963) %>%
  mutate(Period = floor((`Year of order` + 1) / 5),
         Supplier = case_when(str_detect(Supplier, "Denmark|France|Germany|Italy|Netherlands|Spain|Sweden|United Kingdom") ~ "Western Europe",
                              Supplier %in% c("Russia", "Soviet Union") ~ "Russia/USSR",
                              TRUE ~ Supplier)) %>%
  group_by(Period, Supplier) %>%
  summarize(TIV = sum(`SIPRI TIV for total order`)) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  mutate(TIV = TIV / sum(TIV)) %>%
  filter(Supplier %in% c("Russia/USSR", "United States", "Western Europe")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Supplier, values_from = TIV, values_fill = 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Period, names_to = "Supplier", values_to = "TIV") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(str_c(Period * 5 - 1, Period * 5 + 3, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = TIV, color = Supplier, group = Supplier)) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Diversification of the Indian Navy's Suppliers (1964-2023)") +
  labs(caption = "Note: Western Europe includes Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom") +
  xlab("Year of Order") +
  ylab("Proportion of Naval Arms Purchases") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
ggsave("../Images/arms_proportion.jpg", width = 7.5, height = 4.5)
```

# Exercises

## Load data

```{r}
exercises <- read_xlsx("../Data/Exercises.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet2")
exercises <- exercises[1:81, 1:13]
```

## Overall numbers

```{r}
exercises %>%
  filter(Year != 2024) %>%
  count(Year, Type) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, fill = Type)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
exercises %>%
  filter(Year != 2024) %>%
  mutate(RU = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "RU"), 1, 0),
         AU = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "AU"), 1, 0),
         JP = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "JP"), 1, 0),
         US = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "US"), 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarize(across(RU:US, sum)) %>%
  mutate(QU = (AU + JP + US) / 3) %>%
  select(Year, RU, QU) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "Country", values_to = "n") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, color = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
exercises %>%
  mutate(Participants = case_when(str_count(Partners, "AU|JP|US") < NumPartners ~ "Quad+",
                                  str_detect(Partners, "AU|JP|US") ~ "Quad",
                                  TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Participants), is.na(Phase) | Phase == 1) %>%
  count(Year, Participants) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, fill = Participants)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
exercises %>%
  mutate(NumPartners = case_when(NumPartners == 1 ~ "1",
                                 NumPartners < 10 ~ "2-9",
                                 TRUE ~ "10+")) %>%
  count(Year, NumPartners) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, color = NumPartners)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
exercises %>%
  filter(Year != 2024) %>%
  mutate(RU = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "RU"), 1, 0),
         AU = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "AU"), 1, 0),
         JP = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "JP"), 1, 0),
         US = if_else(str_detect(Partners, "US"), 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarize(across(RU:US, sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "Partner", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(Partner = factor(case_when(Partner == "AU" ~ "Australia",
                                    Partner == "JP" ~ "Japan",
                                    Partner == "US" ~ "United States",
                                    Partner == "RU" ~ "Russia"),
                          levels = c("Australia", "Japan", "United States", "Russia"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Year), y = n, fill = Partner)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  # ggtitle("Indian Navy: Average Number of Joint Exercises Per Year (2017-2023)") +
  scale_y_continuous("Number of Exercises", breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8DA0CB", "#E78AC3", "#FC8D62", "#66C2A5")) +
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())
ggsave("../Images/exercises_average.jpg", height = 4, width = 4.1)
```

## Regular exercises

```{r}
exercises %>%
  filter(Type == "Regular") %>%
  mutate(Name = case_when(Name == "CUTLASS EXPRESS" ~ "IMX/CE",
                          str_detect(Name, "INDRA") ~ "INDRA",
                          TRUE ~ Name),
         Alignment = case_when(str_detect(Name, "INDRA|VOSTOK") ~ "Russia",
                               str_detect(Name, "KOMODO|MILAN") ~ "Multilateral",
                               str_detect(Name, "IMX/CE|LA PEROUSE|KAKADU|RIMPAC|SEA DRAGON") ~ "Quad+",
                               TRUE ~ "Quad")) %>%
  count(Year, Name, Alignment) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), factor)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = fct_reorder(fct_rev(Name), as.integer(Alignment), .desc = TRUE), color = Alignment)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Regular Exercises with Quad Members and Russia (2017-March 2024)") +
  labs(subtitle = "EXERCISE",
       caption = "\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nNote: Only years confirmed by press releases or news articles are shown") +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Key", 
                       labels = c(
                         "Multilateral: Including Russia and at least one Quad country                                                   ", 
                         "Quad: Some or all Quad countries", 
                         "Quad+: At least one Quad country and one other country", 
                         "Russia"
                        )) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_minimal() %+replace%
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.085, face = "italic"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = c(-0.2, -0.1),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"))
ggsave("../Images/exercises_regular.jpg", height = 5.5)
```

```{r}
exercises %>%
  filter(Type == "Regular") %>%
  mutate(Name = case_when(Name == "CUTLASS EXPRESS" ~ "IMX/CE",
                          str_detect(Name, "INDRA") ~ "INDRA",
                          TRUE ~ Name),
         Alignment = case_when(str_detect(Name, "INDRA|VOSTOK") ~ "Russia",
                               str_detect(Name, "KOMODO|MILAN") ~ "Multilateral",
                               str_detect(Name, "IMX/CE|LA PEROUSE|KAKADU|RIMPAC|SEA DRAGON") ~ "Quad+",
                               TRUE ~ "Quad"),
         ShipsPerParticipant = TotalShips / (NumPartners + 1)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Name) %>%
  summarize(ShipsPerParticipant = mean(ShipsPerParticipant, na.rm = TRUE), Alignment = Alignment[1]) %>%
  mutate(across(-ShipsPerParticipant, factor)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = fct_reorder(Name, as.integer(Alignment), .desc = TRUE), color = Alignment, size = ShipsPerParticipant)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
  filter(Name %in% c("PASSEX", "MPX"))
```
